name: Meghmani Organics Ltd
title: Meghmani Organics Ltd - 543331 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Crop Protection FY26 EBITDA margin 15% with Q4 at about 9% as raw-material pass-through lagged; TiO2 suspended and no capex, but management reiterated 15-17% Crop Protection margin for FY27 without numbers on volume.

utilisation.quote: the capacity utilization for the segment stood at about 72%

capex.quote: there won't be any significant capex in the current financial year. Only the routine capex to the tune of about INR35 crores to INR40 crores

triggers.label: TiO2 suspended, no capex
triggers.quote: In Titanium Dioxide, we have temporarily suspended our operation due to commercial unviability.

triggers.label: Pigment peers raising prices
triggers.quote: everyone has tried to increase the price or reduce the production. So that is helping in better realization

triggers.label: Crop Protection price pass-through lagging
triggers.quote: we were not able to pass on the price increase immediately to the customer

triggers.label: No customer inventory in US/LatAm
triggers.quote: There is no significant inventory in the market and that the demand from those markets is very good.

guidance.quote: we believe that there will be double -digit growth in top line in Crop Protection segment
in the top line point of view, it will be in the range of somewhere INR500 crores to INR600 crores.
Only the routine capex to the tune of about INR35 crores to INR40 crores will be there.

guidance.value: reasonably good dividend, subject to Board approval
guidance.quote: we'll try to provide a reasonably good dividend to the investors.

prior_guidance_check.quote: Quarter 4 was one of the odd quarters where the geopolitical situation arise d and we were not able to pass on the price increase immediately

red_flags.label: Q4 Crop Protection margin ~9% vs 15-17% guide
red_flags.quote: EBITDA margin for the segment stood at about 9%.

red_flags.label: Standalone Q4 EBITDA ~INR26 crore; TiO2 unit idle
red_flags.quote: Even this quarter result, we are not operationally profitable.

evasions.quote: So on a quarter -on-quarter basis, it is difficult.
Our capacity is 5 crores bottles per year.
it would be difficult to mention on quarter -on-quarter, but year as a whole
